milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the oak trapdoor at spawn-relative [0, 0, 6] and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=5 ensures the player has walked close enough to clearly see the trapdoor on the ground, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking in its direction.

Uses count_in_box_at_least(kind='block', object='water_cauldron') because filling a cauldron with water changes the block type from minecraft:cauldron to minecraft:water_cauldron. This directly verifies the cauldron has been filled. The box [-3, -1, 5] to [3, 3, 11] is a generous ±3 region around the cauldron at [0, 1, 8] to account for any coordinate imprecision. The scene starts with an empty cauldron (block type 'cauldron'), so this rule is NOT satisfied at initialization.
